name: Yashiro Tougo
source:
The [url=/c137978/]heroine[/url]'s older brother. Apart from being overly anxious and overprotective, and being a bit unlucky, he has no other obvious flaws. He is cheerful and has a sociable personality. He has a collecting habit, so he is always collecting something (ranging from freebies that come with tea to luxury items).

[Edited from the [url=https://breakmycase.com/character/togo-yashiro/]official website[/url]]
